basic_details.job_title: HAL X-Ray Technician Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One post of X-Ray Technician (Part Time/Visit Basis) is to be filled at the Industrial Health Center of Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, in Bangalore. General Manager(HR), Industrial Health Center, Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, Suranjandas Road, (Near Old Airport), Bangalore-560 017, and must reach on or before 9 December 2026.

Post only, in the enclosed application format

content_sections.heading: About HAL
content_sections.text: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) describes itself in the notice as a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking and a premier aeronautics complex in South Asia under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, engaged in the design, development, manufacture, maintenance, repair, overhaul and upgrade of aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, accessories, avionics and systems. According to the notice, HAL has 20 Production Divisions, 10 Research & Development Centres and one Facilities Management Division spread across 7 states and 10 locations in India. This post is with the HAL Industrial Health Center, Vimanapura Post, Bangalore - 560017.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The HAL X-Ray Technician application must be sent by POST only, strictly in the application format enclosed with the notice, and must reach on or before 9 December 2026. Resume or application sent through e-mail will not be entertained. Address: Dy. General Manager(HR), Industrial Health Center, Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, Suranjandas Road, (Near Old Airport), Bangalore-560 017 On the envelope: "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF X-RAY TECHNICIAN" Form: the application format attached to the notice, neatly typed or hand written, with a passport size photograph affixed The application form asks for full name in block letters, gender, father's and mother's names, date of birth and age as on 01/11/2026, state of domicile and nationality, religion, category (SC, ST, OBC, GEN, PWD, EX-SM or EWS), communication and permanent addresses with contact numbers and e-mail, expected remuneration per visit, details of any close relatives working in HAL, details of any earlier interview with HAL, educational qualifications and experience as on 01/11/2026 in chronological order, followed by a signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post: X-Ray Technician (Part Time/Visit Basis), at the HAL Industrial Health Center, Bangalore-560 017. Qualification: SSLC / PUC with Diploma in X-Ray Technology. Experience: Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience in the discipline as on 01/11/2026. Age limit: Preferably below 55 years as on 01/11/2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Tenure: Initially for a period of 2 years, renewable at the discretion of the Management. Number of visits: 3 visits in a week, which may be enhanced depending on the requirement. The remuneration is fixed per visit and depends on the candidate's qualification: The amounts are printed as the maximum payable per visit; the notice does not mention any other allowance. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

rows.details: Application format to be filled and sent by post

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the HAL X-Ray Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of X-Ray Technician (Part Time/Visit Basis) at the HAL Industrial Health Center, Bangalore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the HAL X-Ray Technician application?
faq.answer: The application must reach the HAL Industrial Health Center by post on or before 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the HAL X-Ray Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates need SSLC / PUC with Diploma in X-Ray Technology and a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification experience in the discipline as on 01/11/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the HAL X-Ray Technician post?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 55 years as on 01/11/2026.

faq.question: Q5. How much does the HAL X-Ray Technician post pay?
faq.answer: The maximum amount payable is Rs. 1300 per visit for SSLC with Diploma and Rs. 1400 per visit for PUC with Diploma in the concerned discipline.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the HAL X-Ray Technician post?
faq.answer: Fill in the enclosed application format and send it by post to Dy. General Manager(HR), Industrial Health Center, Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, Suranjandas Road, (Near Old Airport), Bangalore-560 017, in an envelope superscribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF X-RAY TECHNICIAN".

faq.question: Q7. Can I send the HAL X-Ray Technician application by e-mail?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that a resume or application sent through e-mail will not be entertained; applications are accepted by post only.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the HAL X-Ray Technician engagement and how many visits are required?
faq.answer: The engagement is initially for 2 years, renewable at the discretion of the Management, with 3 visits in a week that may be enhanced depending on the requirement.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be enclosed with the HAL X-Ray Technician application?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of certificates in support of date of birth, educational qualifications and experience must be enclosed, and a passport size photograph must be affixed on the form.
